name: project_health_check
description:
Inspects a local project and reports its Git state, detected languages and package manifests, available runtimes, declared test/lint/build commands, and common setup gaps. It never runs project scripts or changes files.
Use when: starting work in an unfamiliar repository, deciding what validation to run, or diagnosing missing setup before a build or test.
Scope: local filesystem and local Git metadata only. Read-only.
Not for: executing tests or commands, scanning source code for secrets (use repo_scanner), or auditing dependencies for CVEs (use dependency_audit).

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the project directory. Example: '/Users/me/projects/my-app' or '.'.

include_runtime_versions.description: Report versions for detected local runtimes when their executables are available. This does not install anything. Default: true.
